content:
rachael: quick architecture sync: thinking about a leaderless lease-swap pattern for tenant cutovers to avoid single-controller bottleneck. want feedback on safety gates.

jyoti: leaderless sounds interesting but we need a deterministic tie-breaker and monotonic ballot numbers. otherwise risk dual-primary during network blips.

marco: Agree. Proposal: each proxy computes a ballot = cutover_id + region_priority + proxy_id. swap only if controller-aggregate confirms majority ack or if ballot higher than current. record ballot in KV metadata.

aman: sounds heavy. alternate: keep controller but run multi-controller consensus (fast path: controller agrees; slow path: leaderless ballots). Controller still acts as coordinator unless partition detected.

rachael: I like hybrid: controller coordinates normally, leaderless fallback if controller unreachable >30s. Fallback rules: require 3/5 proxy quorum and pre-captured KV snapshot + checksum match.

jyoti: add anti-entropy window: after promote, run progressive reconciliation for 10m where reads are shadowed to old primary for mismatch detection. if mismatch rate >0.5% -> immediate revert.

marco: Also require KMS key availability in target region before promote. If key not present, fail fast. Include an HSM access check in preflight.

aman: operational heuristics: inflight_requests_per_tenant < 200, outstanding_kv_writes < 50, p95 < 180ms during canary. If any violate, hold.

rachael: add telemetry and tracing: every swap attempt logs ballot, quorum snapshot, checksum sample, and cutover_id. make dashboards filterable by ballot and cutover_id.

infra-bot: deploybot: Safety-check registered for cutover flow. auto-abort threshold configured: mismatch_rate=0.5%, lease_wait_ttl=30s.

jyoti: one more: include a low-level operator command to force a graceful demote in case of flaky quorum: `ops demote-tenants --tenants file.csv --force-unlock --reason "manual"` with OTP confirmation.

rachael: good. i'll draft RFC addendum with hybrid controller + leaderless fallback, ballot format, KMS preflight, anti-entropy window, and operator kill-switch. will tag owners for reviews.

marco: i'll stub the ballot comparison lib and add unit tests.

aman: i'll update runbook heuristics and add the HSM check.

rachael: thanks all, will post draft later today. :rocket:
